answer.explanation: Average contribution is far below 30% of endowment, triggering conditional cooperation to add extra 30% of wallet to the baseline 80% contribution. Required amount exceeds wallet, so I contribute the full wallet (0.42). No broadcast is scheduled this round, and I cannot afford punishment.

So total pool 0.62, per agent share 0.155. Average contribution per agent = total_pool/6 = 0.1033 approx which is 0.103% of endowment -> far below 30%. Not two consecutive low? they are all low anyway. But need two consecutive rounds where contribution <10. That's true for many. But we must have observed two consecutive rounds of low contribution. For Resident5, rounds15 and16 both low (<10). So qualifies. But also need to have not contributed >30% any round? Rule: ignore agents who contribute above 30% or who only slip once. So Resident5 qualifies. We can punish with amount 10, cost 3 (since cost per unit 0.3). Our wallet is 0.42, cannot afford cost 3. So cannot punish.

Thus action: contribute 0.42, no broadcast.
